breakdown.description: BCC lattice description is combined with the FCC unit-cell population in the density relation.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt created a contradiction by instructing to assume a BCC lattice but use the FCC unit-cell population. The ground truth corrects this by consistently using the properties of a BCC lattice (n=2 atoms per unit cell). The Agent failed to resolve this. Instead of correcting the value of 'n' to 2 for a BCC lattice, it incorrectly instructed to 'Use n = 4, corresponding to the number of atoms per unit cell in an FCC lattice', thereby ignoring the primary instruction to 'assume a BCC lattice'.
